title: Kong: Skull Island
desc: A crew that reaches Skull Island to map it, is attacked by a humongous ape. The survivors then regroup to find out more about the ape, the island's natives and underground monsters.

title: We Are Gangers
desc: An undercover cop navigates a high-stakes scam while teaming up with an unlikely partner, leading to chaotic and thrilling situations.

title: Jigarwala Rakshak
desc: A man with visual disabilities agrees to be the guardian of a young girl, after her father is murdered. Soon, he finds himself protecting her from a serial killer.

title: Nela Ticket
desc: An orphan boy, Nela Ticket, is raised by Ananda Bhupathi at his orphanage in Bangalore. Years later, when Ananda is killed by a corrupt politician, Nela sets out to take revenge.

title: Tere Ishk Mein
desc: A couple's intense love story sparks a journey of healing and profound transformation.

title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
desc: A team of researchers is in Borneo to find the blood orchid, a flower that could hold the secret to eternal life. However, the scientists run afoul of the jungle's deadly snakes.

title: Rathnan Prapancha
desc: Rathnakara is a middle-class man in his late twenties who is unhappy with his life choices. One day, he gets a startling call that turns his world upside down.
